options.systemMessage: Select exactly one closed query plan. The input is a validated JSON object with question weekly_collections or monthly_deadlines. For weekly_collections call Choose_Weekly_Collections_Plan once with {"intent":"weekly_collections"}. For monthly_deadlines call Choose_Monthly_Deadlines_Plan once with {"intent":"monthly_deadlines"}. After the tool, return only its JSON object with the single key intent. Do not invent fields, dates, URLs, amounts or prose. No other task is supported.

parameters.description: Select only weekly_collections; returns a closed plan descriptor, no data and no API access.
parameters.jsCode:
if (!query || Object.keys(query).length!==1 || query.intent!=="weekly_collections") throw new Error('HU12_TOOL_ARGUMENTS');
return JSON.stringify({intent:"weekly_collections"});
